Let \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) be position vectors of the points A and B respectively.
\(\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} - 6\hat{j} + 8\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\).
Suppose R(\(\vec{r}\)) is the point which divides the line segment joining A(\(\vec{a}\)) and B(\(\vec{b}\)) internally in the ratio 1 : 3, then
\(\vec{r} = \dfrac{1(\vec{b}) + 3(\vec{a})}{1+3} = \dfrac{1(-\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-4\hat{k}) + 3(2\hat{i}-6\hat{j}+8\hat{k})}{4}\)
\(\therefore \vec{r} = \dfrac{5\hat{i} - 15\hat{j} + 20\hat{k}}{4}\)
Therefore, the coordinates of the point R are \(\left(\dfrac{5}{4}, \dfrac{-15}{4}, 5\right)\).
note: b = -i + 3j - 4k was written -1(i + 3j - 4k), which is -i - 3j + 4k; the next line already uses b correctly, so only the sign placement changes.
